create_FixedThresholdClassifier: create a FixedThresholdClassifier wrapping a binary classifier with a custom decision threshold
test_TunedThresholdClassifierCV: test TunedThresholdClassifierCV to optimize a custom scoring metric by tuning the decision threshold
